mapper.select: SELECT id,business_no,title,process_key,definition_version,created_by,status,round_no,created_at,updated_at FROM approval_application a WHERE tenant_id=#{argument1} AND (a.created_by=#{argument2} OR (a.id IN (SELECT v.TEXT_ FROM ACT_RU_VARIABLE v JOIN ACT_RU_TASK t ON t.PROC_INST_ID_=v.PROC_INST_ID_ WHERE v.TASK_ID_ IS NULL AND v.NAME_='applicationId' AND v.TYPE_='string' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACT_RU_VARIABLE tenant WHERE tenant.PROC_INST_ID_=t.PROC_INST_ID_ AND tenant.TASK_ID_ IS NULL AND tenant.NAME_='tenantId' AND tenant.TYPE_='string' AND tenant.TEXT_=#{argument3}) AND (t.ASSIGNEE_=#{argument4} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACT_RU_IDENTITYLINK i WHERE i.TASK_ID_=t.ID_ AND (i.USER_ID_=#{argument5} OR i.GROUP_ID_ IN (#{parameter}))))) OR a.id IN (SELECT v.TEXT_ FROM ACT_HI_VARINST v JOIN ACT_HI_TASKINST h ON h.PROC_INST_ID_=v.PROC_INST_ID_ WHERE h.ASSIGNEE_=#{argument6} AND v.TASK_ID_ IS NULL AND v.NAME_='applicationId' AND v.VAR_TYPE_='string' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACT_HI_VARINST tenant WHERE tenant.PROC_INST_ID_=h.PROC_INST_ID_ AND tenant.TASK_ID_ IS NULL AND tenant.NAME_='tenantId' AND tenant.VAR_TYPE_='string' AND tenant.TEXT_=#{argument7}))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_event e WHERE e.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND e.application_id=a.id AND e.actor_id=#{argument8} AND e.aggregate_type='Task' AND e.action IN ('APPROVE','RETURN','REJECT','TRANSFER','DELEGATE','RESOLVE','ADD_SIGNER','REMOVE_SIGNER'))) AND (LOWER(title) LIKE #{argument9} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(business_no) LIKE #{argument10} ESCAPE '!') AND status=#{argument11} AND process_key=#{argument12} AND definition_version=#{argument13} AND created_by=#{argument14} AND created_at>=#{argument15} AND created_at<#{argument16} AND (created_at<#{argument17} OR (created_at=#{argument18} AND id<#{argument19})) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{argument20}
